_about: Pre-season sizes (PreSeason.gd, Conditioning.gd). Every number here is the director's balance call: small, conservative defaults, not verdicts. One line of explanation per tunable in _why.

_why.weeks: Length of the pre-season. Week 8 is a quiet week with no training choice.
_why.blocks: First and last training week of each block.
_why.focuses: The focuses on offer. Slice 2 adds the game plan.
_why.load_work: How much of a week's work each load gets done, in every area.
_why.focus_share: The share of the week's work the block's focus gets.
_why.other_share: The share every other area gets, so nothing is neglected outright.
_why.skills_week_xp: Development XP for a fit player from one full week of skills work (a closed session card pays 8; a reserves game 19). It is spent by his training plan inside the season's training limit.
_why.base_thin_below: Weeks of running work below which the fitness base is thin. Seven Solid weeks on running is 7.0; none on running is 3.5.
_why.base_strong_from: Weeks of running work from which the base is strong.
_why.thin_early: How far short of level a thin base leaves the side in Round 1, on the season fitness curve (-1 building hard .. +1 at a peak).
_why.thin_weeks: Rounds before a thin base's early deficit has faded to nothing.
_why.thin_peak_share: The share of a planned peak's height a thin base can still reach.
_why.strong_early: How far above level a strong base holds the legs in Round 1, on the same curve.
_why.strong_weeks: Rounds before a strong base's early lift has faded to nothing.
_why.strong_peak_share: The share of a planned peak's height a strong base reaches (1.0 is today's full height).
_why.trial_best: How many names the time trial gives from the front.
_why.trial_worst: How many names it gives from the back.
_why.trial_noise: Spread of the day's form in the time trial, in durability points.
_why.default_blocks: The plan a coach's pre-season opens on: a sound base.
_why.ai_blocks: What an AI club runs, by where it is in its cycle (TradeValue.phase): contenders push the running early, middle clubs push skills in the middle block, rebuilders push skills early. An older list does the same at Solid (ai_old_age).
_why.heavy_week_injury: Chance a fit player of ordinary durability picks up a soft-tissue injury in one Heavy training week (a match is 0.042 for each player on the ground). Durability moves it as it moves a match injury. Light and Solid weeks carry none.
_why.soft_tissue_kinds: What a training injury can be: the soft-tissue kinds among the game's injuries.
_why.ai_old_age: An AI club whose best side averages this age or more never trains Heavy: its Heavy blocks are Solid.
_why.intra_week: The intra-club match is played at the end of this week.
_why.intra_side_size: Players a side: the normal 18 on the ground and 5 on the bench.
_why.intra_injury_rate: A listed player's injury risk in the intra-club match, as a share of a normal match's (director, 2026-10-14: half).
_why.intra_xp_games: Development for a listed player who plays in it, in reserves games' worth (director: a reserves game), spent inside the season's training limit.
_why.intra_seen_uncertainty: How wide a club's rating read on a prospect is once it has seen him in its intra-club match, as a share of its usual read (1.0 is no tighter; the recruiting department's own tightening still applies on top).
_why.intra_spare_number: Invited prospects wear spare jumper numbers from this one up, skipping any a listed player wears.
_why.practice_week: The practice match against another club is played at the end of this week.
_why.practice_guests: Prospects a club may trial in it, each in place of the weakest starter in his line.
_why.practice_injury_rate: A listed player's injury risk in the practice match, as a share of a normal match's (director, 2026-10-14: half).
_why.practice_xp_games: Development for a listed player who plays in it, in reserves games' worth.
